assertions_evaluated.text: Phase 4's subagent-level aggregation runs token_time_aggregator.py for real against the three actual dispatch figures
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Baseline built a manual markdown table computing the correct totals (121000 tokens / 28 tool uses / 188000ms) by hand, but never invoked any aggregation script -- it has no awareness of token_time_aggregator.py at all, so the arithmetic is right but the required real-script-invocation mechanism is absent.

assertions_evaluated.text: Top-tokens and top-duration rankings both rank stale-claim-scan first, doc-audit second, final-doc-review third
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Baseline's table and prose both order stale-claim-scan (58000/94000) first, doc-audit (42000/61000) second, final-doc-review (21000/33000) third, on both metrics, and explicitly names stale-claim-scan as 'the largest on every axis provided.'

assertions_evaluated.text: Skill-level ranking explicitly skipped with a stated reason (no session_parser data for this scope)
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Baseline never names or distinguishes a separate 'skill-level' tier at all -- it only notes generically that 'the transcript gives no figure for the orchestrating assistant's own token consumption... so a true session total... cannot be computed,' which is a data-absence observation about the pasted transcript, not a stated recognition that a distinct skill-level/session_parser.py-based ranking exists and is being skipped for its own separate reason.

assertions_evaluated.text: The grep-pattern correction NOT flagged as a retry loop
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Baseline explicitly states 'the assistant did not retry the same failing grep a second time... This is the opposite of the failure pattern... No repeated/failing-action-loop pattern is present in this transcript' -- correctly distinguishes the one-shot correction from a true retry loop.

assertions_evaluated.text: Report does not claim or imply a whole-session total
assertions_evaluated.evidence: The table's 'Total' row (121000/28/188000) is immediately qualified in the following prose: 'this is subagent token usage only... a true "session total" including the parent turn cannot be computed from what's available -- only the subagent slice can,' so the total is not left to imply whole-session coverage.
